svg.title: Execution time versus Vertices V
svg.desc: Arithmetic means of five measured runs. Whiskers show the observed minimum and maximum, not a confidence interval. The horizontal axis is logarithmic; each scenario panel has its own linear millisecond scale. Points are connected by straight segments. Source data: all-summary.csv and all-runs.csv.

g.text: Mean of 5 measured runs; whiskers: min-max. Three warm-up runs are excluded.
Logarithmic horizontal axis; independent linear time scales in the three panels.
